q1_issues.issue: The bare-plural group 'wraiths' gets only the group-level rise event; a distributive predicate over a group is also supposed to hand the predication to the members via an (Implication (PartOf $x sk_group_1) ...) rule, which is absent.

q2_gaps: reduplicated iterative adverbial ('again and again') on an episodic past-perfect clause — the unary (Again e) tag records only that some prior same-type event occurred, and no licensed head carries the repeated multiplicity (Every/TimesPer need a stated period or rate, and the frequency-adverb dial is for generics/habituals)
notes: Name/kind handling of 'the Stilllight Lantern', the no-Name default for 'the Council', the past-perfect Before ordering and the main-clause-first Because atom are all correct.
